feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass-fed beef is solely fed pasture grasses and hay

resold_note: Also sells pasture-raised chicken from Middlefork Meadows in Rossville, Indiana.
notes: Not the same farm as holy-cow-beef (Lubbock, TX); this is a farm with an on-farm butcher shop north of Monon, Indiana. Checked 2026-11-15: homepage, our farm, grass-fed beef, grain-finished beef and chicken pages. Two beef lines: grass-fed beef fed only pasture grasses and hay, and grain-finished beef given the farm's own non-GMO corn in the last 3 to 6 months, so the category is both. Pork is pasture-raised and lamb is called 100% grass-fed. Bulk custom orders go through the on-farm butcher, but no page seen offers quarter, half or whole shares by name, so bulk_shares is false. Pickup at the farm store (Thu and Fri 12 to 5, Sat 10 to 2, Mon to Wed by appointment) or shipping anywhere in Indiana, free on $150 or more. The site says pricing is being updated.
